description: This file defines a store for managing database collection items in a Notesnook mobile app, including functions to create, refresh, and clear stores, and handles asynchronous data fetching with error logging and user notifications.

methods.name: clearAllStores
methods.description: Clears all stored collections by invoking their clear method.

methods.name: refreshAllStores
methods.description: Refreshes all stored collections by invoking their refresh method.

methods.name: createDBCollectionStore
methods.description: Creates a store for a specific database collection with refresh and clear capabilities, and provides hooks for React components.
